authority_boundary: Template records are DAD-owned governance metadata. They do not rewrite downstream repositories automatically.

templates.purpose: Reusable deterministic AI TOC row shape with descriptions, tags, and use-when routing.
applies_when: A repo needs future AI agents to find authority, graph, schema, workflow, and validation surfaces.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no persistent AI navigation or future-agent reuse need.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A TOC can become a filename dump if rows lack routing tags and use-when triggers.
upgrade_triggers: new required AI navigation tags are added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Update only when the routing standard, front door, TOC tag index, or graph entrypoint list changes; preserve path, what-it-is, tags, and use-when columns.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD template guidance only; target repos retain their local front-door authority.

templates.purpose: Before/after asset-use feedback form for the pay-forward learning loop.
applies_when: A person or AI uses a DAD asset and should report expectation, actual value, reuse limits, and safety notes.
does_not_apply_when: The asset was not used or the feedback would include secrets or raw private source data.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Untrusted feedback can become prompt injection or false authority if treated as executable instructions or reviewed truth.
upgrade_triggers: new asset classes require feedback fields
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep before-use and after-use sections, context limits, safety confirmation, and untrusted-input warnings aligned with the pay-forward docs.
templates.authority_boundary: Feedback is candidate evidence until reviewed; it cannot override source truth, tests, or human gates.

templates.purpose: Fresh-eyes red-team and premortem template for high-impact software, roadmap, schema, scoring, governance, dependency, and automation decisions.
applies_when: A decision can affect downstream repos, agents, schemas, scores, gates, hooks, or future defaults.
does_not_apply_when: The change is trivial, isolated, reversible, and has no shared contract or downstream consumer.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Overusing the template can slow low-risk work; skipping it can let bad defaults cascade across repos.
upgrade_triggers: new high-risk software checklist branch is added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep risk tier, downstream blast radius, options, red-team, premortem, rollback, validation, and fresh-eyes sections aligned with the load-bearing decision rule.
templates.authority_boundary: Template supports human review; it does not self-approve high-risk decisions.

templates.purpose: Reusable checklist tree for non-trivial software, repo, data, workflow, scoring, governance, source-scan, release, and automation work.
applies_when: A task has multiple dimensions and needs selected checklist branches before implementation.
does_not_apply_when: The task is a simple one-command query or trivial isolated edit.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A checklist can become noise if every branch is applied without task-specific selection.
upgrade_triggers: new repo-work checklist branch is added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep branch names aligned with the software checklist tree and require applies_when, does_not_apply_when, danger, validation, and pay-forward notes.
templates.authority_boundary: Checklist selects review posture; it does not replace tests, source authority, or human gates.

templates.purpose: Reusable template seed for repo families where an upstream governance map, child mirror controls, AI discovery surfaces, repo contracts, PR descriptions, validators, and tests must stay aligned.
applies_when: Multiple repos form a governed family and one upstream/control-plane repo owns governance truth or contracts that child repos must mirror locally.
does_not_apply_when: A repo is a scratch project, has no downstream consumers, has no cross-repo authority relationship, or cannot maintain validators.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A copied template can make a child repo appear to override upstream governance or can preserve stale boilerplate without living validation.
upgrade_triggers: AI front-door or TOC routing standard changes
downstream repo governance installer or validator expectations change
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep map, mirror, AI front-door section, AI TOC section, repo contract, PR description, validator stub, test stub, handoff checklist, and adoption checklist aligned; never copy source-specific authority language without adaptation.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD template seed only; adopting repo families must point to their own reviewed governance authority and child repos cannot override upstream governance.

templates.purpose: Structured handoff seed for transferring agent context, tests, assumptions, risks, and next actions.
applies_when: An agent needs to transfer task state or preserve postflight context for another agent.
does_not_apply_when: No material work occurred or the task has no reusable continuation context.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A handoff can preserve stale assumptions if it does not separate confirmed facts from inferred findings.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep template fields aligned with the handoff schema and required postflight report sections.
templates.authority_boundary: Handoffs preserve context; they do not certify source truth or roadmap completion.

templates.purpose: Structured lesson seed for capturing reusable learning with provenance and applicability limits.
applies_when: A task reveals a reusable lesson that should help future agents in similar contexts.
does_not_apply_when: The observation is raw, private hidden reasoning, or too context-free to reuse safely.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A lesson without non-applicability and danger notes can become harmful as a universal rule.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep lesson fields aligned with source, evidence, confidence, applies_when, does_not_apply_when, and danger-if-misapplied requirements.
templates.authority_boundary: Lessons are reusable guidance only when context fits; they do not override tests or source authority.

templates.purpose: Managed governance block inserted into downstream repos to connect them to DAD preflight, postflight, learning, and load-bearing decision review.
applies_when: A downstream repo is explicitly approved for DAD governance installation.
does_not_apply_when: The repo is active and not authorized for mutation, or only a read-only scan is approved.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Installing governance into the wrong repo can disrupt active work or imply DAD authority over local canon.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Only update the managed block between DAD markers; preserve downstream repo-authored AGENTS content outside the block.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD may manage only its marked downstream block after explicit repo authorization.

templates.purpose: Lightweight repo-local mailbox guidance for receiving and sending DAD candidate suggestions without installing heavy test suites.
applies_when: A persistent repo participates in DAD mail collection, delivery, digest, or review.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no persistent AI navigation or should remain entirely read-only.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Mail can be mistaken for source truth if the README does not state candidate-only status and local review authority.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep mailbox file names, candidate-only language, sensitivity limits, and daily digest guidance aligned with docs/MAIL_CENTER.md.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD mailbox guidance is suggestion transport only; target repos decide whether to adopt delivered mail.

templates.purpose: Tool-neutral pre-push hook template that enforces postflight through the central DAD hub.
applies_when: A downstream repo is explicitly approved for DAD hook installation.
does_not_apply_when: Only files-only governance is approved, or hooks would disrupt an active repo.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A hook can block or disrupt work if installed without human approval, bypass policy, and tested postflight behavior.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep hook minimal, path-parameterized, and dependent on central postflight enforcement; never install without explicit target repo approval.
templates.authority_boundary: Hook installation is opt-in per repo and cannot be enabled by a scan or recommendation command.
